items.title: Section: Fulfilling-Requests Meditation — Curing Disease, Calling Down Rain, and Making an Otherwise Powerless Mantra Work

items.zh: 云何菩薩遂求靜慮？謂此靜慮略有八種。一者、於諸毒藥、霜雹、毒熱、鬼所魅等種種災患能息，能成呪術所依靜慮；二者、於界互違所生眾病能除靜慮；三者、於諸飢饉大災旱等現在前時，興致甘雨靜慮；四者、於其種種人非人作水陸怖畏，能正拔濟靜慮；五者、於乏飲食墮在曠野諸有情類，能施飲食靜慮；六者、於乏財位所化有情，能施種種財位靜慮；七者、於十方界放逸有情，能正諫誨靜慮；八者、於諸有情隨所生起所應作事，能正造作靜慮。
items.en: What is a bodhisattva's fulfilling-requests meditative concentration? This meditation is, in brief, of eight kinds. First, meditation capable of dispelling every kind of disaster — poison, hail, deadly fever, demonic affliction — and of making mantras genuinely effective in doing so. Second, meditation capable of eliminating illness arising from imbalance among the body's own elements. Third, meditation capable of summoning genuine rain when famine or severe drought is genuinely present. Fourth, meditation capable of correctly rescuing beings from every kind of danger on water or on land, whether from human or non-human threat. Fifth, meditation capable of providing food to beings stranded in the wilderness without any. Sixth, meditation capable of providing every kind of wealth to beings in genuine need of it. Seventh, meditation capable of correctly admonishing and instructing careless beings throughout the worlds of the ten directions. Eighth, meditation capable of correctly carrying out whatever task genuinely arises for beings.

items.title: Section: Both-Worlds-Happiness Meditation — Miraculous Teaching, Restoring Eloquence, and Light Cast Into Hell

items.zh: 云何菩薩此世他世樂靜慮？謂此靜慮略有九種。一者、神通變現調伏有情靜慮；二者、記說變現調伏有情靜慮；三者、教誡變現調伏有情靜慮；四者、於造惡者示現惡趣靜慮；五者、於失辯者能施辯才靜慮；六者、於失念者能施正念靜慮；七者、制造建立無顛倒論、微妙讚頌摩怛理迦，能令正法久住靜慮；八者、於諸世間工巧業處，能引義利，饒益有情種種書算、測度、數印、床座、傘屧，如是等類種種差別資生眾具能隨造作靜慮；九者、於生惡趣所化有情，為欲暫時息彼眾苦，放大光明照觸靜慮。
items.en: What is a bodhisattva's meditative concentration of happiness in this world and the next? This meditation is, in brief, of nine kinds. First, meditation that guides beings through miraculous physical transformation. Second, meditation that guides beings through mind-reading revelation. Third, meditation that guides beings through direct instruction. Fourth, meditation that reveals to wrongdoers the lower rebirth their conduct is heading towards. Fifth, meditation that restores eloquence to those who have lost it. Sixth, meditation that restores mindfulness to those who have forgotten it. Seventh, meditation that composes and establishes genuinely correct treatises and refined verses of praise, foundational analyses that keep the true teaching alive in the world. Eighth, meditation that skilfully produces, for beings' genuine benefit, whatever practical arts and crafts the world requires — calligraphy, arithmetic, surveying, seals, furniture, umbrellas, and every other kind of genuinely useful article. Ninth, meditation that radiates great light to grant even a temporary respite from suffering to beings born into the lower realms.

items.title: Section: The Ten Purity Meditations Close the Entire Chapter on the Perfection of Meditative Concentration

items.zh: 云何菩薩清淨靜慮？謂此靜慮略有十種。一者、由世間淨，離諸愛味清淨靜慮。二者、由出世淨，無有染污清淨靜慮。三者、由加行淨，清淨靜慮。四者、由得根本淨，清淨靜慮。五者、由根本勝進淨，清淨靜慮。六者、由入、住、出自在淨，清淨靜慮。七者、捨靜慮已，復還證入自在淨，清淨靜慮。八者、神通變現自在淨，清淨靜慮。九者、離一切見趣淨，清淨靜慮。十者、一切煩惱、所知障淨，清淨靜慮。如是靜慮無量無邊，能得菩薩大菩提果。菩薩依此圓滿靜慮波羅蜜多，能於無上正等菩提速疾已證、當證、今證。
items.en: What is a bodhisattva's purity meditative concentration? This meditation is, in brief, of ten kinds. First, purity through worldly meditation, free of attachment to its own pleasurable taste. Second, purity through transcendent meditation, entirely free of affliction. Third, purity through preparatory approach. Fourth, purity through actually attaining the root absorptions. Fifth, purity through progressing further within those root absorptions. Sixth, purity through mastery entering, abiding in, and emerging from absorption at will. Seventh, purity through mastery of setting an absorption aside and re-entering it again, even in reverse order. Eighth, purity through mastery of supernormal display. Ninth, purity through freedom from every non-Buddhist view. Tenth, purity through freedom from every affliction and every obstruction to complete knowledge. Meditative concentration of this kind is immeasurable and boundless, bringing about a bodhisattva's great fruit of awakening. Relying on this, bodhisattvas fulfil the perfection of meditative concentration, and are able to swiftly realise supreme, complete awakening — whether already realised, soon to be realised, or being realised even now.

items.title: Section: The Perfection of Wisdom Opens — Intrinsic Nature Spanning All Five Classical Fields of Knowledge

items.zh: 云何菩薩慧波羅蜜多？嗢拕南曰：自性、一切、難、一切門、善士、一切種、遂求、二世樂、清淨，如是九種相，是名略說慧。謂九種相慧，名為菩薩慧波羅蜜多。一者、自性慧，二者、一切慧，三者、難行慧，四者、一切門慧，五者、善士慧，六者、一切種慧，七者、遂求慧，八者、此世他世樂慧，九者、清淨慧。云何菩薩自性慧？謂能悟入一切所知及已悟入一切所知簡擇諸法，普緣一切五明處轉。一、內明處，二、因明處，三、醫方明處，四、聲明處，五、工業明處。當知即是菩薩一切慧之自性。
items.en: From the Bodhisattva Stage within the Basic Section, the chapter on the initial yoga foundation, chapter fourteen: wisdom. What is a bodhisattva's perfection of wisdom? A summary verse states: "Intrinsic nature, comprehensive scope, difficult practice; comprehensive gateways, virtuous persons; comprehensive kinds, fulfilling requests; both-worlds happiness, purity — these nine kinds of mark are, in brief, called wisdom." These nine marks of wisdom together constitute a bodhisattva's perfection of wisdom: first, the wisdom of intrinsic nature; second, comprehensive wisdom; third, the wisdom of difficult practice; fourth, comprehensive-gateway wisdom; fifth, virtuous-person wisdom; sixth, comprehensive-kind wisdom; seventh, fulfilling-requests wisdom; eighth, the wisdom of happiness in this world and the next; ninth, purity wisdom. What is a bodhisattva's wisdom of intrinsic nature? The capacity to genuinely awaken to, and having genuinely awakened to, discern all phenomena within the entire scope of what can be known, extending universally across all five classical fields of knowledge: first, inner wisdom; second, logic; third, medicine; fourth, linguistics; fifth, the practical arts. One should understand this to be a bodhisattva's own intrinsic nature of wisdom.

items.title: Section: Comprehensive Wisdom Opens — the Three Stages of Approaching, Realising, and Following Through on Ultimate Truth

items.zh: 云何菩薩一切慧？當知此慧略有二種。一者、世間慧，二者、出世間慧。此二略說復有三種。一、能於所知真實隨覺通達慧，二、能於如所說五明處及三聚中決定善巧慧，三、能作一切有情義利慧。若諸菩薩於離言說法無我性，或於真諦將欲覺悟、或於真諦正覺寤時，或於真諦覺寤已後所有妙慧。最勝寂靜明了現前，無有分別，離諸戲論；於一切法悟平等性，入大總相；究達一切所知邊際，遠離增益、損減二邊，順入中道。是名菩薩能於所知真實隨覺通達慧。
items.en: What is a bodhisattva's comprehensive wisdom? One should know this wisdom is, in brief, of two kinds: first, worldly wisdom; second, transcendent wisdom. These two, in brief, further unfold into three kinds: first, wisdom genuinely awakening to and penetrating the true nature of what can be known; second, wisdom skilfully mastering the five classical fields of knowledge already described, together with the three categories of teaching; third, wisdom actively working for the benefit of every being. Bodhisattvas whose genuinely excellent wisdom regarding the selflessness of phenomena beyond all language — when just approaching awakening to it, is utterly and supremely still, clearly manifest, free of conceptual discrimination, and free of all elaboration; when genuinely awakening to it in the moment, awakens to the fundamental equality of all phenomena, entering the great universal characteristic; and, having already awakened to it, thoroughly penetrates the very limits of everything knowable, released from both the extreme of adding what is not there and the extreme of subtracting what genuinely is, entering correctly into the middle way — this is called a bodhisattva's wisdom genuinely awakening to and penetrating the true nature of what can be known.

blocks.text: How concentration serves others, then the perfection of wisdom begins.

Concentration "capable of dispelling every disaster: poison, hail, fever, demonic harm"; curing illness; "calling down sweet rain in drought"; rescuing from fear; producing wealth for the poor. Master Cháng Bǎi: a mantra of Chan master Pu'an was useless when ordinary people recited it, effective when a bodhisattva did.

Guiding beings through miraculous transformation, through reading minds, through instruction; restoring eloquence; and "emitting great light towards beings in the lower realms, relieving their suffering for a time".
Ten kinds, including worldly concentration "free of attachment to its taste", and transcendent concentration.

"Encompassing all five fields of knowledge." Master Cháng Bǎi: a bodhisattva must not neglect any. Venerable Miào Jìng, after Kuiji: "able to penetrate all knowables" is non-conceptual wisdom; "having penetrated, discerning dharmas" is subsequent wisdom.

Wisdom "awakening to and penetrating the true nature of what can be known" (before, at, and after realisation); wisdom mastering the five fields and the three categories of teaching (what leads to benefit, to harm, and to neither); and wisdom working for every being. Master Cháng Bǎi: "following" is the preparatory stage.

quiz.q: What is the third of the eight fulfilling-requests meditations?
options: bringing rain in famine and drought
quiz.why: "Third, meditation calling down sweet rain when famine and great drought arise." Master Cháng Bǎi: "suì" means accomplishing; "qiú" is what is hoped for.

quiz.q: The first meditation "makes mantras effective." How do the lectures relate mantras and concentration?
options: Cháng Bǎi: like Chan master Pu'an's mantra — useless for ordinary people, effective for bodhisattvas; Miào Jìng: with concentration as basis, reciting the mantra works
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: Chan master Pu'an had a mantra that could dispel disasters — useless when ordinary people recite it, effective when a bodhisattva does. Venerable Miào Jìng: with concentration as the basis, reciting the mantra has this power.

quiz.q: What is the last of the nine two-world meditations?
options: for beings born in lower realms, emitting great light to relieve their suffering temporarily
quiz.why: "Ninth, meditation emitting great light towards beings born in the lower realms, to relieve their suffering for a time." Master Cháng Bǎi: emitting great light to illuminate the hells so their suffering pauses for a while.

quiz.q: The seventh purity, "having left an absorption, re-entering it at will," is rendered with "even in reverse order." Do the lectures support this?
options: yes: Miào Jìng — leaving the absorption, earlier shallow to deep, here deep to shallow; Cháng Bǎi — from the fourth straight to the first
quiz.why: Venerable Miào Jìng: "leaving the absorption" means coming out of it; earlier, entering, abiding, and exiting went from shallow to deep — here from deep to shallow. Master Cháng Bǎi: for example, coming out of the fourth absorption directly into the first. The English addition is supported.

quiz.q: Which five fields of knowledge does intrinsic wisdom encompass?
options: inner science, logic, medicine, linguistics, crafts
quiz.why: "Encompassing all five fields of knowledge: inner science, logic, medicine, linguistics, and crafts." Master Cháng Bǎi: a bodhisattva must not only understand the world-transcending dharma but also be skilled in worldly knowledge.

quiz.q: Comprehensive wisdom unfolds into which three kinds?
options: wisdom penetrating the true nature of the knowable, wisdom mastering the five fields and three categories, wisdom benefiting all beings
quiz.why: "First, wisdom awakening to and penetrating the true nature of what can be known; second, wisdom mastering the five fields and three categories; third, wisdom benefiting all beings." Venerable Miào Jìng: even contemplating all dharmas as empty in the four foundations is still worldly wisdom.

quiz.q: The English says these qualities apply "in every stage." How does Master Cháng Bǎi read the passage?
options: read as three parallel groups, each stage with its own qualities: preparatory, fundamental, and subsequent non-conceptual wisdom
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: by the wisdoms and their characteristics, the passage breaks into three parallel segments; "following" is preparatory non-conceptual wisdom, "awakening" fundamental, "penetrating" subsequent. The English applies every quality to every stage.
